name: NTPC Green Energy Ltd.
about: NTPC Green Energy Limited engages in the renewable energy generation business in India. The company has a portfolio of 26,544 MWs solar and wind power projects. It also offers consultancy services, project management, and supervision services. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in New Delhi, India. NTPC Green Energy Limited is a subsidiary of NTPC Limited.

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~47% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 13.7% cost of equity).
PE of 107 is near the bottom of its range over the last 2 years (median 179), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 107 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 176 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
High leverage (D/E 1.7x) raises risk; equity value is sensitive to interest costs.
